svg.title: Suspected meningitis or encephalitis: blood culture and empiric treatment first, CT before the lumbar puncture only with focal signs or a decreased level of consciousness, then the CSF separates bacterial meningitis, aseptic (viral) meningitis and herpes simplex encephalitis, each with its organisms and treatment

svg.text: Fever · headache · stiff neck · altered mental status: think MENINGITIS

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: classic triad: FEVER, ALTERED MENTAL STATUS, NUCHAL RIGIDITY (Kernig's, Brudzinski's)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: language trouble, confusion, focal seizures → think ENCEPHALITIS (the brain itself)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Suspected CNS infection: treat FIRST, then let the CSF decide

svg.text: 2 · START EMPIRIC treatment now: never wait for the CT or the tap

svg.text: 3 · CT/MRI FIRST only if focal signs or ↓ consciousness (PUNISH: Papilledema, Unconscious, Neurologic deficit, Immunocompromised, Seizure,
